This error is because the `.env` file is not a writable directory by default. To fix this, you can add the following line to your `~/.bashrc` file (or your preferred configuration file):

```bash
export WritableDir=.env
```

Then, restart your terminal or run `source ~/.bashrc` to apply the changes.
